model: PM6-D3H4 zero-damping D3 dispersion over the parity-gated CHNO domain
dispatch: one GPU thread per molecule with no cross-molecule atomics

inputs.atoms: packed float4 positions and uint4 atomic identity
inputs.referenceTables: checked-in CHNO C6/CN interpolation records and r0 pair radii

outputs.dispersionEv: one float32 dispersion energy per molecule

precision: float32 Metal with mandatory float64 CPU parity gate
